notes.title: Dev Diary #12 | Computers, energy, and more...
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/c939c71b7495ef04a691836ad5c2ba3131deefe9.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1][p]Hope you’re all doing well, because we’ve got another round of updates fresh off the workbench. Old-school computers and the power that keeps things running - there’s plenty to share. Let’s not waste time and jump right in![/p][p][/p][h2]Telstar 3000[/h2][p]First up, let’s take a closer look at the computer. It might look unassuming, but don’t let that fool you - this is one of the most advanced systems humming in the world of ExeKiller. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/90a093811798cfac54ac0c5591beac7e8a74c6d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It features realistic mouse input simulation, so you’ll actually feel like you’re working with real hardware. You can control all energy-based systems right from the interface, mount external drives, encrypt or decrypt files, and even download the entire computer state onto a portable storage device. Later, you can plug it into another terminal![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to a modular design, it’s easy to keep adding new programs and functions. Whether you’re hacking into locked doors or powering up abandoned facilities, these terminals will be at the heart of it all.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/d7b0da992f750aea4def25d18ccc60f828e562a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/5ca58d8f964c82d7ac6f855fe73372626b927212.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you haven’t watched the clip yet, now’s the time. You’ll see exactly why this terminal is such an essential tool for anyone trying to survive - or get ahead.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aNU9ans1Uwk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Power Systems[/h2][p]Of course, none of that matters without energy. The second video shows our power system. Circuits, switches, connections - it all has to be managed.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/c089cdd3aaea978ea4c7735756ef373eb7ed9a28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can power any energy-based device with universal batteries, connect anything to anything, and even set up logic rules with boolean operators to create interesting solutions to environmental puzzles. Doors, lights, computers, vehicles - it’s all fair game. [/p][p][/p][p]And if you’re in a tight spot, don’t forget you can use energy to your advantage in combat - blow up power sources to disable enemy defenses or hook up batteries to support your own gear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/d344dc23021b9ee11cae7123b0fa86a2b3f6ed91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It might sound simple, but trust us - when everything goes dark in the middle of a job, you’ll wish you’d paid more attention to the wiring. And that’s where CyberVision comes in. This special mode lets you trace power lines through walls and floors, helping you spot hidden connections and solve environmental puzzles if you ever get trapped.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s definitely a lot you’ll be able to do here, but… We’ll save that for another time.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="W36j9mBzdvs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]A little treat…[/h2][p]We’ve also got something a bit lighter to share. Say hi to well-known Winston - and yes, he’s finally got his own set of GIFs ready to roam the internet![/p][p][/p][p]If you’re looking to add a bit of wasteland spirit to your chats or posts, grab these GIFs and let Winston do the talking. If you end up using them, tag us or drop a link - we’d love to see them in action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/5e7e5e238f9039f491dc3227bc206aef6fc2d1ed.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/21353cfe7b11fadcc400b1d11703feb217edea66.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/eb8d08ae1fee4fad6508657a4932de68aef2d675.gif"][/img][/p][p]Feel free to download and use it on your social media - [b][u][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nZpVEfjbjtpq9jGkWrjuzB2k9glG_fCV?usp=sharing"]JUST CLICK HERE[/url][/u][/b]! [/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks for Being Here[/h2][p]Before we wrap up - big thanks to everyone for helping us hit 900 members on Discord ([b][url="https://discord.gg/VPDpnpbB7W"]join here[/url][/b]). That kind of support means everything, and it’s what keeps us going day after day.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/61ca688adb4de20e503370d6477b700da9fb172a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you haven’t joined yet, come say hi - the door’s always open (unless you run into a locked one, but that’s what lockpicks are for - [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1701840/view/502823294872846800"]check it yourself[/url][/b] ;)).[/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to follow us on [url="https://www.facebook.com/ParadarkStudio"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://twitter.com/ParadarkStudio"]X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/paradarkstudio"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/paradarkstudio.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url] to stay up to date. More updates, previews, and surprises are just around the corner.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Until next time,
Paradark Studio[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary #11 | Sneak peak inside the Tower
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/90c13cc68800e419912bedb51f27b891885b699f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1]

Today we're [b]stepping inside the Tower[/b] - starting in the parking lot, moving into the neon glow of Cyberance, and checking out our lockpick. Oh, and don’t forget about the cold, calculating presence of Police Bots. Buckle up!

[h2]Lockpick[/h2]

In the wasteland, nothing opens by asking nicely - [b]especially not locked doors[/b]. That’s where your lockpick comes in. It’s a tool built for the job, complete with a flashy interface that tells you exactly what you're up against. The more lights you see, the tougher the lock - and the more pins you’ll need to hit just right.

[b]The mechanism’s simple[/b] - align the tumblers, feel the feedback, and make it click. Use it right, and locked doors become new paths. Secret rooms. Shortcuts. Stashes no one’s touched in years. In a place like this, knowing how to crack a lock isn’t a bonus - it’s survival.

[previewyoutube=NX6140Jd984;full][/previewyoutube]

But hey, if you’re not the patient type, [b]there’s always the direct approach[/b] - smash the padlock and move on. Just be warned - it’s loud and might draw attention you really don’t want. Not exactly the go-to move for silent thieves trying to stay in the shadows… 

[h2]A Parking Lot[/h2]

Next, [b]we go to the lower tower parking spot[/b] - a place that’s still in use, though it doesn’t exactly roll out the welcome mat.

Way down, under the ground, with big walls of steel and hard rock, low lights blink and big air fans hum. It's not loud, but it doesn't feel nice. There’s definitely a lot you’ll be able to do there, but… [b]We’ll save that for another time[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/bdda9533473979e27e7c6f6b2bfaf534040deb5f.jpg[/img]

Just don’t stick around too long. Someone - [b]or something[/b] - might be watching.

[h2]Cyberance[/h2]

[b]Cyberance is the place in the upper Tower[/b] to be if you’ve got power, connections, or just enough credits to buy your way in. The neon glow makes it look inviting, but don’t be fooled.

Started by Mr. B, the big boss of many dark city moves, Cyberance is the place where folks go to [b]hit it big or fall hard[/b]. Drinks keep coming, beats hit hard, and in the back, big deals go down that change the wasteland and the Tower itself.

If you ever find yourself inside, tread carefully…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/446b7df15ea05ee039b9121acf92d8071df5e851.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/5f5c340d2a6c3f01ab8c1661fada4ff08a185051.jpg[/img]

[h2]Law Enforcement[/h2]

In ExeKiller, [b]the police don’t wear badges or play nice[/b] - they’re cold, unflinching Police Bots. No hesitation, no talking things out. Just orders, carried out without a second thought. Without any thought.

Wearing tough black fake leather, these cops aren’t just going for the scary look - [b]they’ve got it down[/b]. The bright red mark on their back? If you see one coming your way, you’d better hope you’re not on their list.

Because once they lock onto a target, [b]they never quit[/b]…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/8fe65c3af98c0b2257f5cae5f7811bc8a285ce5b.jpg[/img]

[h2]In the end…[/h2]

That’s it for today, but [b]we’re just getting started[/b]. More updates, more gameplay, and more sneak peeks are on the way, so keep your eyes peeled, Partners!

Also - huge thanks to all of you for helping us [b]cross 10,000 followers on X and hit 800 members on Discord[/b]! That kind of support means the world to us, and it keeps the fire burning as we push forward with ExeKiller. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/fe83f846a0b69ed703849387fbf2ec58324abb9f.jpg[/img]

If you’re not part of the ride yet - now’s the time to hop on. Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/ParadarkStudio]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ParadarkStudio]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/paradarkstudio]Instagram[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/paradarkstudio.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url], and most importantly - [b][url=https://discord.gg/VPDpnpbB7W]join our Discord[/url][/b]. The wasteland’s a tough place, but it’s a lot better when you’ve got allies. That’s how you survive! 

[i]Until next time,
Paradark Studio[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary #10 | King Hotel, Sparky, Animations, and more…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/7bef5ad7777fd29a7f200226ac026e38f19d568f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1]

Hope you’re all doing well and are ready for another [b]update from the world of ExeKiller[/b]. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and today we’ve got a few exciting things to share with you. Let’s dive right in!

[h2]Hotel[/h2]

First up, we’ve got [b]a glimpse of the King Hotel[/b]! Now, don’t expect fancy suites or lavish decor - this isn’t that kind of place. Well, at least not anymore… 

[b]Once a symbol of luxury in Brooklyn[/b], where the elite sipped from crystal glasses beneath golden chandeliers, striking deals behind closed doors. And now? The wind howls through its hollow halls, and the only ones left are outlaws, fugitives, and those who live by their own rules (it was recently claimed by the Blind Justice gang)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/01f7f2ec17871161a7969df2e3eee7f103c14203.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/96064f77170ce2f021dfc1d293b72b2f9062a929.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/07cb8449958822b8117ec54d223e3fd713b40e85.jpg[/img]

And hey, if you’re in the area, [b]don’t ask about those available rooms[/b]...

[h2]Sparky[/h2]

Next, [b]let’s talk about Sparky[/b] - the all-purpose welder turned survival essential. Built by Techtronik, this compact yet powerful tool is a must-have for anyone navigating the wasteland.

Primarily used for [b]repairing vehicles and welding or fixing damaged cables[/b], Sparky keeps things running when everything else is falling apart. And if you’re feeling creative, well… Let’s just say some wastelanders have found a more artistic use for it, leaving their mark one glowing line at a time. 

Just be careful where you point it… [b]Accidents do happen[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/5202d7470efe6925c12f765787a3b69635abdd5a.gif[/img]

[h2]Animations Update[/h2]

Now, time for something a little more... [b]Deadly[/b]! We’ve improved animations for NPCs, meaning you’ll get to see some dramatic (and sometimes comical) falls when things go south. It’s a small detail, but it adds an extra layer of realism to the game.

Don’t just take our word for it - check out this [b]compilation of spectacular deaths[/b]. We hope you’ll enjoy the results!

[previewyoutube=NWPm48rTVkk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Computers[/h2]

[b]Meet Veritas[/b] - a seemingly old terminal, but in reality, a vital tool of Helion. Created by Techtronik, a company specializing in advanced electronics, this high-tech computer is used for personality and usability tests - for example, determining whether someone is still fit to be an ExeKiller.

Its keys may be worn, and its screen may flicker, but [b]its purpose remains unchanged[/b]. This is no mere relic of the past - it’s a mechanism of selection, the final judgment that can decide a person’s fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/8c9158117bff8f9b0d1a59cc5452545b6784f19a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/4f64845d35e3bb80f174d654fd9875b801784475.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Milestones[/h2]

Before we wrap up, we just want to thank our growing community. We’re so close to hitting [b]750 members on Discord[/b] and [b]surpassed 9000 followers on X[/b]! Your support means everything to us, and we’re excited to have you along for the ride. If you haven’t joined us yet, don’t miss out – be part of the action and follow us on Facebook, X, and Instagram!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/4b9f1c8264228a00b469d5e27761522a666c7a87.jpg[/img]

[h2]Wrapping Up[/h2]

That’s all for today, but there’s plenty more coming your way soon. Thanks for sticking with us, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next. Stay tuned, follow us on [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ParadarkStudio]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ParadarkStudio]X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/paradarkstudio.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/paradarkstudio]Instagram[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://discord.gg/VPDpnpbB7W]join our Discord[/url][/b]! We’re waiting for any new members, and we’ve got some fun surprises waiting for you!

[i]Cheers
Paradark Studio[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary #09 | New milestones, Drones, Astron, and more…

First up, let's talk about drones! In ExeKiller they may occasionally catch your eye when flying above, but beware – they’re not just for show. Stay alert and be careful when drones are nearby!

We showed them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1701840/announcements/detail/6501581293021449572]previous Dev Diary[/url], but this time let's take a better look!

[h1]Partners![/h1]

We hope you're all doing great and that you enjoyed our last devlog. We're always thrilled to [b]keep you in the loop[/b] with what's cooking on the development front!

Today, we're diving into some of the recent goodies we've been working on. Expect mutated creatures, a sprinkle of futuristic gadgets, and - of course - [b]some wardrobe essentials to kick things off[/b]!

Worn Citrolla hat! You can check out the concept art and its in-game render to see how it evolved. We hope we managed to get that gritty post-apocalyptic vibe.

notes.title: Dev Diary #7 | New buildings, car, climbing, and more…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/1bba20f06acb6552f8e6df6a39d33d735937f509.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1]

[b]Welcome in 2024[/b]! Just twelve months left until we step into the release year of ExeKiller... Time flies when you're knee-deep in game development, right?

Recently, we welcomed a bunch of new members to the Paradark team, confidently progressing toward the direction we've set. Even though there is still a long way to go, we're eager to share with you the progress we’ve made over the last couple of weeks!

[h2]New buildings [/h2]

Alright, let's chat about those new buildings we've been working on! So, remember how our Discord crew voted for the City Ruins biome? [b]Well, it's happening[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/0f04049adc512951e23aed7b950dd4e3aca40697.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/c8c5b6c39f1810327349e310938e48b469d4b9ed.png[/img]

[h2]Car WIP [/h2]

Shifting gears to the wheels and rides. We've been getting down and dirty with textures and fine-tuning the car model. We could talk your ear off about all the little tweaks and details, but let's cut to the chase: you gotta see it to believe it.

We're all ears for your thoughts on this! [b]Your feedback is priceless[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/1311c1d9c080be7d87b7ef3716ae54964cc85a57.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/1484e708ce81bd4559f995b3954fc47a560d3907.png[/img]

[h2]Climb, climb, climb… [/h2]

Lately we've been pouring a lot of energy into [b]crafting climbing mechanics[/b], and we're thrilled to show you what we’ve come up with. 

[previewyoutube=JYATZXxMsR8;full]Ladder Video[/previewyoutube]

Just a heads-up, this isn't the end game yet, so [b]expect a few tweaks down the road[/b]. Still, even at this point, we're thrilled to know how you like it!

[h2]Social milestones[/h2]

And hey, let's give ourselves a pat on the back for some big wins on the social scene! We've crossed the 500-member milestone on our Discord server (how cool is that?!), and our Twitter is skyrocketing with over [b]3100 followers[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/89a9ab4919a2b681d0dc851a840a113280ab5e76.png[/img]

Huge shoutout to everyone who's been spreading the love and joined our community.

[h2]Music for your ears![/h2]

While we don't have any new concept art today, we've got something special for you on YouTube – the latest track that will be featured in the game. 

Consider this the first taste of what's to come! Grab your headphones and [b]vibe with us[/b].

[previewyoutube=gaiP4Dl4niA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Thank you! [/h2]

Before we wrap things up, we just wanted to say a huge thanks for diving into our dev diary and for all the amazing support you've given us. Honestly, [b]it means the world to us[/b]!

Feel free to join our Discord server ([b][url=https://discord.gg/VPDpnpbB7W]JUST CLICK HERE[/url][/b]) for more direct interaction, and don't forget to follow us on social media for regular updates:

📍 [url=https://www.instagram.com/paradarkstudio]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: Dev Diary #6 | Subway Showcase, vending machine, Winston, and more…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/0ffd23d45290a35cfe8931d40a1cbd9965dc0acf.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1]

As 2024 is just around the corner, we're excited to share what we've been working on over the past few weeks. It's been quite a journey, and we can't wait to show you the latest developments in ExeKiller! Come with us! 

[h2]Epic Games[/h2]

Before we move on to the news about our game, we would like to clarify a misunderstanding that has been caused by our recent announcement regarding the Epic Mega Grant.

Even though we did receive the Grant, it does not mean that ExeKiller will be available exclusively on Epic Games Store and we would like to make that very clear. We want as many people as possible to enjoy our upcoming game, so we have no plans of making it exclusive (or temporarily exclusive) to any platform.

The support from Epic Games changes absolutely nothing, except that we now have additional resources to further refine ExeKiller, which will benefit everyone!

[h2]Gas Mask[/h2]

Let's kick things off with the Gas Mask. In a post-apocalyptic world, it can be a lifesaver, and we've paid close attention to the details to make it both realistic and appropriately eerie.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/50b229a26f8fc16484c4d5be9ac7e0af4f10adf7.png[/img]

[h2]Vending Machine[/h2]

Do you like vending machines? Who doesn't! As you might guess, you'll also be able to come across them in the world of ExeKiller. Recently we've been working on them a bit and we can now show you the first results!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/c8600dbc1eae9f970e27dac4e3d385041cc9c405.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/e2b0336e50a34fca5d7af34c5efe3c12e1407b1b.png[/img]

They are produced by Nutronix Corporation, which specializes in food production. Importantly, these won't be static models in the game, but fully interactive devices - you'll be able to find company products in them! Sometimes they might save your health or even your lives!

[h2]Say hello to Winston! [/h2]

Now, let's introduce you to Winston – the '60s sensation from Robotion Company! Winston, a stylish robot designed for household tasks, has evolved towards conquering factories and dazzling as an office clerk. His color-changing jumpsuit adds a touch of flair to each task, making him not just a robotic assistant, but a fashionable companion for the future as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/5c9820d450b49bf0162d3561f4ceb1a1fa88aa2d.gif[/img]

Oh, and we advise you to remember Winston. We have a feeling you'll meet him more than once… ;)

[h2]Subway[/h2]

It's time for the cherry on top! Would you like to see the level we've been working on lately? Be our guest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/f8a8aaec0ca42cad5a0606cb5c60c6cdf4f82eb9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/bc7cb46441833511774216ca6f888d57e7e48af5.png[/img]

The level may look great, but we’re warning you - danger lurks around every corner! The Blind Justice faction is hiding there, but... More on that later!

[h2]See you! [/h2]

Lastly, we want to express our gratitude for your continued support and interest in the development of ExeKiller. The game is created for you and with you, and we hope to keep crafting a project that fulfills our shared dreams.

What’s more - remember that you are always welcome on [b][url=https://discord.gg/P39DsM9tca] our Discord server[/url][/b]! By joining, you can help us develop the game - recently, there has been a question regarding skills, so we are waiting for your votes!

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/b832f407300536c6500ed0077d57d303b7854f57.gif[/img]

[i]Thank you for being a part of this incredible journey[/i]!

Best regards,
Paradark Studio

notes.title: Dev Diary #5 | Mocap session, combat animations, and more…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/24ce4eac6695d30dcaaf68145f3195257e9e2483.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy, Partners![/h1]

As promised, we're committed to keeping you in the loop with our ongoing development. We want you to witness the evolution of ExeKiller in real time, so today we have some truly exciting things to share! Let us show you…

[h2]Mocap Session[/h2]

We've noticed your feedback regarding animations in the game and you can rest assured, we are not turning a blind eye to your comments - we're taking action!

[previewyoutube=xhLuWlHwHk4;full][/previewyoutube]

In a recent motion capture session, we had the opportunity to document some movements that will be integrated into the game. Our main goal is to enhance immersion and bring the game world closer to reality! At least when it comes to motion!

[h2]Beat them up![/h2]

But that's not all! In our pursuit of realism, we're paying attention to every animation detail. Today, we're thrilled to showcase what we've been working on recently - combat animations. Check out how effectively you can take down Winston!

[previewyoutube=agwy8oxY5Sw;full][/previewyoutube]

It would be safe to say that our opponents won't have an easy time with us… There will be more combat techniques, but we’ll tell you more about them another time!

[h2]Turrets[/h2]

Furthermore, we're excited to announce that we've completed and textured some new 3D models. And let us introduce one of them - the turret. This dangerous tool will make your life harder in the game, and learning how to defend against it will be essential for survival.
 
Beware, it can be quite deadly! Take a look for yourselves:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/2c2be9844b2160918b73c0858a4b94a1e6e0eb8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/35206d71b2be110a041e34913c54d5a7d250c9a9.png[/img]

[h2]There's more in store…[/h2]

For those of you who have stuck with us until this point, we have a little surprise - a highly atmospheric concept art. We hope you enjoy it!

And we think it's a great idea to turn this into a tradition - a visual treat at the end of each dev diary. What would you say?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/9b3640b4b94ad2428017371bf86a7a2787bd2ca7.png[/img]

[h2]See ya! [/h2]

Finally, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your continued presence and support throughout Exekiller's development. We are working hard to deliver the best possible project by 2025. We're confident that we'll achieve this goal together!

To stay up-to-date and be the first to receive all the latest information, make sure to [b][url=https://discord.gg/P39DsM9tca] join our Discord server[/url][/b]! It's worth mentioning that after joining you will be able to participate in special polls, the results of which have a significant impact on our game. Don't hesitate! 

Warm regards,
Paradark Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 | Fashion, animations and more…
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/69e1fc9a310c8363a9a5af4d50f053489c035158.png[/img]

[h1]Howdy, partners![/h1]

Long time no hear, huh? It's high time to change that! As a token of our appreciation for sticking with us and [b]continuously fueling our progress on Exekiller[/b], we want to keep you in the loop about our progress at least once a month!

So, even though this is the fourth Dev Diary, [b]consider it a sort of a fresh start[/b]! The first of many that will gradually bring us closer to the big day in 2025, when our game will finally debut.

Let's [b]kick off right from the beginning[/b]! Here's what has been happening with us lately!

[h2]Fashion always matters![/h2]

First of all, we are constantly working on fashion. In the past few weeks [b]we've been heavily focused on clothing items and essentials[/b] within the post-apocalyptic world.

[b]Take a look at the leather coat[/b] that some of the outlaws will wear. It seems to resonate perfectly with their demeanor and brings a unique aura to their look. It's likely that foes will have second thoughts before venturing into their path, agreed?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/f3c154925ada791ce8dd5c0901d33d3a78bf61ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/4ffcf4b3d5da1428d9584565926ea27d085b59ea.png[/img]

And if the presentation alone doesn't convince them, we're more than willing to treat them to something stronger! As luck would have it, we've recently been working on a [b]3D model of a grenade[/b] - a truly explosive toy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/c9738748669e140dfacd45095d8eed7c1e40850e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/682dedc4503381d8c9122731d7b828dc7e885b7b.png[/img]

[h2]Moreover…[/h2]

Certainly, visuals matter, but [b]what would game graphics be without proper animations[/b]? In the past few weeks, we've also dedicated our efforts to this aspect, focusing heavily on grenade animations.

[previewyoutube=F_UGSODiRsg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]That’s not all! [/h2]

Did you make it this far? Know that we greatly appreciate it! As a reward, we have a little surprise in the form of a Staten Island concept art. [b]As you can see, it's very atmospheric[/b]. 

And even though you'll often [b]encounter many dangers there[/b], we're striving to make the exploration itself a unique experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/af30e883ee5d9ccb249995e2dac21dbaa500c744.png[/img]

[h2]In the end...[/h2]

As you can see, a lot is happening! And while the road to the release is undoubtedly long, we're continuously working on implementing various features, big and small, to [b]bring Exekiller closer to perfection[/b].

If you want to actively [b]participate in the game's creation[/b], we encourage you to join our Discord. That's where information surfaces first, and you can have direct conversations with us. Don’t hesitate - [url=https://discord.gg/n7KaSmqsSq]click here[/url] and join now! 

See you soon

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41079555/7bdbe539d743de5f046e537d2d3b6f24ee4a01dc.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We have incredible news to share with you! We are absolutely thrilled because we have just signed an agreement with an amazing publisher, [url=https://null.com/]Null Games[/url]. This is exactly the moment we never even dreamed of, not even in our wildest dreams. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to our publisher for the immense trust and support we have already received.

At the same time, we want to inform you that due to the financial support we have received, we will have to postpone the release date of the "ExeKiller" to 2025. It's a tough decision, but we are doing it all to deliver a better game to you. Your satisfaction is our top priority, which is why we want to dedicate more time to perfect every detail.

We understand that you may be concerned about this delay, but we kindly ask for your understanding. Our goal is to create a game that exceeds your wildest expectations. We are working on "Exekiller”  with tremendous dedication, striving for perfection in every aspect.

We are incredibly grateful for your support and trust, which you show us every day. You are the driving force behind our team, and without you, nothing would be possible. We promise that the delay in the release of "Exekiller" is in your best interest.

Thank you for being part of our journey and patiently waiting for what the future holds. Over the next years, we will be working to create a game that will amaze you. Stay strong!

notes.title: ExeKiller | Dev diary 02
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy, partners! Long time no see, right? [/b]

Well, for us it’s been one hell of a ride. Since we last spoke, we've begun the transition to Unreal Engine 5. It's not a walk in the park, but it's a necessary step so that you can immerse yourself in the world of Exekiller the way it was always meant to be - graphically rich, smoothly running and, above all, bug-free. UE5 will help us do this faster and better, especially with new features such as nanite, lumen and so on. 

We left you dry for a few months, but you were never forgotten. We have a treat for you - the latest gameplay from Exekiller's scorched earth homeland,

We hope you will continue to give us that credit of trust, and we promise, it will be repaid with new updates or exctiting news.

See you soon!
Paradark team

notes.title: ExeKiller | Dev diary 01
notes.notes:
Howdy Partners! We have not forgotten about you. Not for a second! We are constantly working hard to make the world of Exekiller open it’s doors for You (and not to open Pandora’s box of bugs).

The last months have been a great challenge for us. We knew that by publishing the teaser trailer for Exekiller, we are making You a promise - and we are taking the promises very seriously! Today we want to thank You for the positive reception of what we presented in the teaser trailer. We read every comment, we listen to Your suggestions and try to implement in the game everything we dreamed of and everything You expect.

Paradark Studio has grown up to team of 12! Every day our programmers, writers, level designers, composer, sound designer, animator, 3d artists combine their forces to create awsome game. 

We have managed to close the script that will play in the first act of Exekiller. Just as we planned, You, our dear player, will take the steering wheel in how the story will unfold. We promised non-linear gameplay, we promised a non-linear storyline - and we'll keep that promise. Your choices won't be cosmetic, they won't be superficial - Your choices will matter. Your revolver will be able to make a difference. Your character will be noticed - whether you’ll be a compassionate or a vengeful hunter.

Many of the things we showed in the trailer have been improved. Not all things will be included in the first act, but all of them will definitely be reflected in the final production.

Although we can't show the gameplay yet because we are polishing this diamond to the limit  still we have a lot to show you.

For starters - Music

Each of us describe the world with all five senses. Sight may be most important in our lives, but hearing often lets you give context to what You see. With that in mind, we can present You with the main musical theme of Exekiller. If you want to hear what this world sounds like – before You can see it firsthand - this is where you have the opportunity to do so!

[previewyoutube=ISlS5Y6Ur3k;full][/previewyoutube]

Today's promise: regular updates of this devdiary.

notes.title: Exekiller looks like a rad western cyberpunk
notes.notes:
We're having a bit of a renaissance of cyberpunk games, it seems. Exekiller is the latest, a cross between the 80s tech of classic cyberpunk and westerner sensibilities.

Exekiller is an action adventure set in 1998 New York, only this NY is taken over by deserts. The events take place 30 years after the Great Fire Disaster (timely!), an environmental crisis that killed 70% of the Earth's population.

Such desperate times, of course, give rise to all-powerful coporations, which control this world after governments fell. You play as the titular Exekiller, a bounty hunter who goes after outlaws to collect their S.O.U.L.S. - a chip that controls them and knows everything about them.
